gloss: to be elegant, to have class, to be refined

definitions.gloss: to be elegant, to have class, to be refined
definitions.explanation: Describes a person, thing, or manner that has an inherent elegance, dignity, or refinement. Used as a compliment for someone or something that exudes good taste and sophistication.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{品|ひん}がある。
⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧です⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: What an elegant way of speaking.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧だ。
examples.english: This traditional restaurant has a refined atmosphere, making it perfect for special occasions.

notes:
An idiomatic expression built on ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (refinement, elegance, class). The negative form ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ means "to lack class" or "to be vulgar." When modifying a noun, the pattern changes to ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧＋noun (e.g., ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧).

⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ here refers to an innate quality of grace and good taste, not "goods" or "items" (another meaning of ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧/⟦{品物|しなもの}→品物：00886_shinamono⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {品|ひん}がある: to have class/refinement
- ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to lack class, to be vulgar
- ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧＋noun: classy/refined + noun
- ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧＋noun: vulgar/classless + noun
- ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to sense elegance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧: elegant, refined — a na-adjective with a similar meaning but usable as a standalone modifier
- ⟦{気品|きひん}→気品：13255_kihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have dignity/grace — slightly more elevated, often for nobility or royalty
- ⟦{品格|ひんかく}→品格：09179_hinkaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have dignity — focuses more on character and moral refinement
